description_en: Retrieves the classifications from a tag mining task
description_zh: 获取某次标签挖掘结果分类
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi get-categories-by-task-id --workspace-id xxxx --task-id xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCategoriesByTaskId

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the task.

You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically generates a task ID. If you specify the same task ID for subsequent tasks, the tasks are considered part of the same conversation group
parameters.help_zh:
任务唯一ID
TaskId默认无需填写，系统将自动生成。当后续任务填写的TaskId相同时，表示这些任务属于同一组对话
parameters.name: task_id
